exceptions.reason: Pocket-TTS requires a loaded mmproj model. Writer supplies only its text-model catalog file, no --mmproj, no multimodal request content or user-controlled worker options. Upstream server-context.cpp at dbe4c3e loads mtmd only when mmproj.path is nonempty. The worker environment is cleared and each loopback worker requires a per-launch secret. This does not clear direct standalone llama-server invocation. See docs/security/windows-0406-dependencies.md.

exceptions.reason: Mirostat assertion path is not used by Writer: pinned common_params_sampling.mirostat defaults to 0, common_sampler_init selects Mirostat only for modes 1/2, and Writer sends a fixed temperature-zero request without a sampler override. User text is serialized inside messages, never merged into generation options. Launch environment is cleared; loopback worker requires a per-launch secret. Standalone invocation is outside this disposition. See docs/security/windows-0406-dependencies.md.

Target absence, not acceptance of a reachable issue; upgrading rustix to 1.1.6 removes it. See docs/security/windows-0410-dependencies.md.
